notional_basis: par: a $N rung sells exactly N frxUSD (input_amount, token units)
excluded_sources_basis: Frax's USDC custodian (exchange 'frxusd') is primary redemption, published separately as redemption_probe; it is not secondary-market depth
reference_basis: smallest SUCCESSFUL rung; size and marginal impact are measured against its rate

cost_conventions.all_in_cost_bps: 1 - USDC out / frxUSD in (par, face value), standing spread included, gas excluded
cost_conventions.all_in_cost_bps_incl_gas: as all_in_cost_bps with KyberSwap's gasUsd estimate deducted from output
cost_conventions.size_impact_bps: 1 - average rate / reference rate. HEADLINE basis
cost_conventions.marginal_impact_bps: 1 - (delta USDC / delta frxUSD since the previous successful rung) / reference rate

headline.value_basis: a FLOOR, not a limit: at least this much clears; the crossing was not located

headline_basis: 50 bps of size impact is the stable-asset headline

marginal_at_headline_bps.value_basis: the last rung that clears; the crossing lies inside bracket_usd and is not interpolated

context_200bps.value_basis: a FLOOR, not a limit: at least this much clears; the crossing was not located

context_200bps_note: secondary context only, never the headline

last_valid_headline.value_basis: a FLOOR, not a limit: at least this much clears; the crossing was not located

last_valid_headline_basis: this run's headline when it located a crossing, bracket or floor; otherwise the previous artifact's, with its own measured_at. A failed run does not erase it
route_venues_scope: pools KyberSwap selected for these exact rungs, deduplicated by (exchange, pool). Executable route evidence, NOT a venue inventory: DexTracker publishes inventory and its filter diagnostics in data/liquidity/frxusd_liquidity.json
scope: canonical Ethereum only; every other network is unmeasured here
